meta.title: Qoder CLI CN subagent
meta.description: Delegates one self-contained task per call to a fresh Qoder CLI CN agent running in the task's working directory, over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), and returns only its final answer or a safe failure. Qoder's own login, settings, memory, skills, and MCP servers stay in effect. Requires Qoder CLI CN (qoderclicn) to be installed and signed in. Permission prompts are answered automatically: Qoder's `auto` mode handles safe reads and edits, and any remaining prompt is rejected unless `permission: allow` is configured.
